packageRules.description: Cooldown before automerge picks up a release: a hijacked package is usually spotted and yanked within days. digest is in here because a digest-only update means an upstream tag moved onto another commit. vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this, so CVE fixes still land at once
Automerge all safe updates (minor/patch/digest) via PR once CI passes
One PR per group keeps the review load sane on a small project
One PR per group keeps the review load sane on a small project

typescript-eslint peers on typescript <6.1.0, so TypeScript 7 fails npm ci outright and takes the whole dev group down with it: every other bump in the group is held hostage. Drop this the day typescript-eslint accepts 7
Actions do not ship in the built image -> group them into one chore PR, no release. They are pinned by SHA, so what moves here is the digest behind a tag and the version comment on the same line
